name: tactical-undo-activate
description: pbd28@54: deepwrought activates 209 (tactic token spent, tactical.move opens), then presses the UNDO shown on the movement prompt (ultimateUndo_N, a back extra on the typed decision). Undo must restore the save before the activation: the tactic token back in the pool, 209 without deepwrought's token, the activation prompt open again.
